model.name: merge.threeColumnSplineRibbon
model.description: The 3-way merge is always 3 side-by-side columns (never stacked, no breakpoint); one continuous cubic-bezier spline per change flows across the gutters (Local->Result->Repository), matching the IntelliJ target. Narrow viewport = horizontal scroll/zoom within the columns. Impl-edit anchor renderConnectorRibbons (boxes->spline); architect designs the spline geometry.
